later, or all sent at once so a script can create a whole lesson and then publish it.
LessonCreateRequest.title: LessonCreateRequest

LessonInsightsOut.description:
How learners do on one version of a lesson. `enough` is false until 5 learners have
finished that version, and then every figure is null. `doc` and `assets` are the
version's deck, for previewing exactly what learners saw.
LessonInsightsOut.title: LessonInsightsOut

LessonOrderRequest.description:
Every lesson's id in one topic, in the new order and in the order the page showed.

`topic_id` is required but may be null, meaning the lessons with no topic. Requiring it
means a request that forgets it is refused instead of reordering the wrong group.
LessonOrderRequest.title: LessonOrderRequest

LessonOut.description:
One lesson as the editor needs it: the draft, what still blocks publishing, counts,
and the images and audio its cards use. `deletable` is true only for a lesson that has
never been published, which is also when its `level` can still change; `version` is the
latest published one.
LessonOut.title: LessonOut

LessonSearchResultOut.description:
One lesson found by search (SCRUM-85): its title, topic and whether this user has
completed it, and the card text that matched. Never says which options are right.
LessonSearchResultOut.title: LessonSearchResultOut

LessonSummaryOut.description: A lesson as the admin portal lists it. The cards are left out to keep the list light.
LessonSummaryOut.title: LessonSummaryOut

LessonUpdateRequest.description:
Change a draft. Fields left out keep their value.

`updated_at` is the "last updated" time the editor loaded. If the lesson has changed
since, the save is refused (lesson_out_of_date) rather than overwriting that change.
LessonUpdateRequest.title: LessonUpdateRequest

MistakeOut.description: A question answered wrongly, as its lesson reads now (SCRUM-44).
MistakeOut.title: MistakeOut

ResetTokenRequest.title: ResetTokenRequest

ScoreOut.description: First-try correct answers out of the scored questions.
ScoreOut.title: ScoreOut

StoryCard.description:
Optional image and audio, then text in Markdown, then optionally a question.

The text may hold one `{{blank}}`, which the question's answer fills.

SuggestionOut.description: The suggested next lesson beside the circles (SCRUM-6, SCRUM-106).

TopicProgressOut.description: One progress circle on the landing page (SCRUM-43).
TopicProgressOut.title: TopicProgressOut

check. Leaving `description` out keeps the current one (empty for a new topic); an empty
string clears it.
TopicRequest.title: TopicRequest

get.description:
Every lesson of every status, without its body, in topic order then lesson order.
Lessons with no topic come last.

schema.title: Response List Lessons Api Admin Lessons Get

post.description:
Create a draft at the end of its topic. `level` (1 to 5) is required; every other field
may be empty, and `doc` may hold the whole deck, so a script can write a lesson in one
request.

404.description: No topic with that id (topic_not_found, field topic_id)

409.description: That topic is archived (topic_archived, field topic_id)

put.description:
Set the order of one topic's lessons, or of those with no topic (`topic_id: null`).
List every lesson in that group exactly once, plus the order the page showed; a page
that was out of date gets 409 order_out_of_date. Lessons are ordered by level first, so
an order that puts a higher level above a lower one gets 409 lesson_order_mixes_levels.
Returns every lesson, in order.

schema.title: Response Reorder Lessons Api Admin Lessons Order Put

409.description: The page was out of date (order_out_of_date), or the order mixes levels (lesson_order_mixes_levels)

delete.description: Delete a lesson that has never been published.

409.description: Published at some point, so withdraw it instead (lesson_not_deletable), or changed since it was loaded (lesson_out_of_date)

get.description: One lesson of any status: its draft, issues, counts and the files its cards use.

patch.description:
Change the draft's title, summary or cards, or the lesson's topic or level; fields
left out are kept. Works whatever the status: users keep seeing the published version
until the draft is published. A new topic moves the lesson to the end of it straight
away; the level can only change before the lesson is first published. Send the
`updated_at` the editor loaded.

404.description: No topic with that id (topic_not_found, field topic_id)

409.description: Changed since it was loaded (lesson_out_of_date), the topic is archived (topic_archived), a published lesson would lose its topic (topic_required), or a published lesson's level would change (level_locked)

post.description: Put the draft back to the latest published version.

409.description: Changed since it was loaded (lesson_out_of_date), or not allowed in the lesson's status (lesson_status_conflict)

get.description:
How learners do on one version of a lesson: who finished it, scores, where they
stop, and each question's answers. No figure is given for fewer than 5 learners, and no
learner is named.
